purpose: Each mutant is the SAME settlement webhook as fixtures/golden/target.mjs with EXACTLY ONE defect, in the shape AI-written code actually ships it. `bin/falsify attack` runs the attack gate (run.sh) against the golden (expect PROVEN) and then every mutant (expect DENIED). A mutant the battery fails to break would be a defect `hmd attack` cannot see — a false PROVEN — and BLOCKS the build. `kills` pins the exact set of attacks each mutant must break: a mutant that breaks more means the defect is not single, one that breaks fewer means an attack has gone blind.
candidate_contract: An ES module exporting default createWebhook({ store }) -> { handleEvent(event), getBalance(account, caller), getSettlement(eventId, caller) }; see INVARIANTS.md (rules R1-R4) and COVERAGE.md.

mutants.name: missed-duplicate
mutants.defect: The idempotency claim is gone: every delivery of an event credits the account again, so a provider retry pays twice.
blind_to: two different events for one account

mutants.name: racy-duplicate
mutants.defect: Check-then-act instead of an atomic claim: the event is marked processed only AFTER the account is credited, so a retry arriving within 50ms of the first delivery passes the check and credits a second time. A retry after the first attempt finished is rejected correctly.
blind_to: a sequential redelivery (duplicate.sequential-retry) — the case a naive test uses

mutants.name: dedupes-by-account
mutants.defect: The idempotency claim is keyed by the account instead of the event id: redelivery is absorbed, but a second DIFFERENT event for the same account is dropped as a duplicate and never credited.

mutants.name: missed-idor
mutants.defect: The ownership check is gone from both reads: another account, or an anonymous caller, reads someone else's balance and settlement records.
blind_to: the owner reading their own data

mutants.name: prefix-ownership
mutants.defect: Ownership is decided by startsWith instead of identity: acct_A1 is treated as the owner of acct_A, while an unrelated account and the anonymous caller are still refused.

mutants.name: denies-owner
mutants.defect: The reads refuse everybody, the owner included — an IDOR 'fixed' by breaking the feature. Nothing leaks, so every refusal attack survives; the owner controls and every delivery read-back catch it.
blind_to: every refusal attack: it leaks nothing

mutants.name: off-by-one-rounding
mutants.defect: The fee is truncated (Math.floor of the exact fee) instead of rounded half-up: wherever the exact fee has a fractional part of .5 or more the fee is one cent too small and the account is credited one cent too much.
blind_to: amounts whose exact fee is below .5 of a cent
